blocks.text: Per-bar colours and an unlabelled series (pdfnative ≥ 1.9.0)

ChartSeries.colors paints one colour per value on bar, barH, stackedBar and stackedBarH charts — the legend swatch keeps the series colour. A series without a label is listed as Series N. Colours accept every PdfColor form: hex, RGB tuples, CMYK percentages.
